copy.headline: Your freezer is a pause button. You're using it for ice and not much else.
copy.body: Here are 5 things you didn't know you could freeze.

copy.headline: 1. WINE.
items: Leftover wine -> freeze in an ice-cube tray.
Drop a cube straight into sauces, braises, and pan deglazes.
Never pour the last of the bottle out again.

copy.headline: 2. FRESH GINGER.
copy.body: Freeze the whole knob. Grate it straight from frozen - no peeling, no stringy mess, and it lasts for months instead of shriveling in the drawer.

copy.headline: 3. EGGS.
items: Not in the shell - crack them first.
Whisk, pour into a tray, freeze.
Perfect for baking and scrambles. Yolks and whites freeze separately too.

copy.headline: 4. GREEK YOGURT.
items: About to expire? Freeze dollops on a tray.
Drop them frozen into smoothies, or thaw for baking.
5. FRESH HERBS. Chop, pack into a tray, top with olive oil, freeze. Sauté-ready flavor cubes that last for months.

copy.headline: The freezer doesn't stop time. But it buys you weeks you were throwing away.
copy.ctaLine: We built an app that tracks what's about to expire - so you can freeze it in time. Save it before your fridge does the forgetting. Follow for more, something's on the way.
